plugins.name: npm-registry-manager
plugins.description: Manage npm registries from Claude Code. Switch between public npm, GitHub Packages, private/enterprise registries, and regional mirrors (taobao, tencent, huawei, yarn, etc.). An nrm/grm replacement that needs only npm for core operations.

plugins.name: npm-package-owner
plugins.description: Manage your published npm packages — pre-publish safety checks, a guarded publish flow (plan → confirm → execute), download stats, and package health overviews. Companion to npm-registry-manager.

plugins.name: ralph-loop-file
plugins.description: Ralph Loop variant that reads its prompt from a file — safe for multi-line prompts containing apostrophes, backticks, or shell-special characters.
